decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with vertical through contacts build on existing capabilities and their technological uncertainty remains unresolved, so the option value justifies the carrying cost.
Carrier wafers for smaller diameters are an incremental extension of the established offer with low carrying cost and still-uncertain niche demand, making the option cheap to hold.
Copper interposer glass wafers align with the firm's packaging-wafer direction and, despite higher cost, their value has not been resolved negatively, so the option is still worth keeping.
The Wafer Universe brand for off-the-shelf wafers is close to the established offer, incurs low additional cost, and likely provides steady revenue with little downside.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the firm's core wafer-processing capabilities, require substantial resources, and the firm has other options with better fit, so the option is no longer worth keeping.
